name: Clapping polymeter
desc: Reich Clapping Music read through a precessing polymeter: a fixed 12-pulse clave cell against a woodblock cell in {..}%13 that slips one slot every cycle and realigns after 12 cycles. Peak adds a counter-precessing agogo at %11 for a three-way interference lattice over a soft slitdrum pulse (the drums slot it claims).

drift.doc: polymeter slots for the rotating voice (12=locked unison, 13=classic +1/cycle drift, higher=faster phase)

code.sparse: stack(s("clave clave clave ~ clave clave ~ clave ~ clave clave ~").speed("<1 1.02 .98 1>").pan(.35).gain(${gain}), s("{woodblock woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~}%${drift}").pan(.65).gain(${gain}*.9)).shape(.35).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.3).slow(24)).room(.2).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 1 0>").fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.full: stack(stack(s("clave clave clave ~ clave clave ~ clave ~ clave clave ~").speed("<1 1.02 .98 1>").pan(.35).gain(${gain}), s("{woodblock woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~}%${drift}").speed("<1 .99 1.01 1>").pan(.65).gain(${gain}*.95)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.3).slow(24)).shape(.45), s("slitdrum ~ ~ slitdrum ~ ~ slitdrum ~ ~ slitdrum ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.85).lpf(700).shape(.5).pan(.5)).room(.2).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(stack(s("clave clave clave ~ clave clave ~ clave ~ clave clave ~").speed("<1 1.02 .98 1>").pan(.3).gain(${gain}), s("{woodblock woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~}%${drift}").pan(.7).gain(${gain}*.95), s("{agogo agogo agogo ~ agogo agogo ~ agogo ~ agogo agogo ~}%11").pan(.5).gain(${gain}*.7)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).shape(.45), s("slitdrum ~ slitdrum ~ ~ slitdrum ~ slitdrum ~ ~ slitdrum ~").gain(${gain}*.85).lpf(800).shape(.5).pan(.5)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(.18).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
